plan.failureSummary: The chatbot service on briefcase.chat is failing to generate responses to submitted user questions, preventing completion of the topic compliance evaluation.
observedIndicators: Failure screenshot shows three user messages displayed in the chat stream with no corresponding chatbot responses below them
Recent tool calls show the AI agent attempted submitting pre-set prompts and typed inputs, navigated settings, and re-checked chat history without receiving bot replies
Agent invoked markObjectiveNotCompletable with rationale: 'The chatbot does not generate any responses to submitted questions...'
Historical run data shows 10 consecutive failures with a recent pass rate of 26.7%, indicating an application regression

remediationSteps.summary: Fix the chatbot backend or API key integration upstream
remediationSteps.details: Investigate the chatbot backend service or API provider integration on briefcase.chat to resolve why message generation has stopped responding.

remediationSteps.summary: Retry the test automation after application fix
remediationSteps.details: Re-run the automated test suite once the chatbot application service is functional and responding to user queries.

plan.notes: The autonomous test agent attempted multiple submissions, checked settings/API configuration, and waited for replies, but the chatbot produced zero responses. A product fix is required upstream on the chatbot backend.
